kind: representation-capability feasibility on public crystal structures (static); no biological, clinical or novelty claim
question: On four public Abl kinase-domain chains with independently stated DFG and A-loop states, which representations separate the stated states: established side-chain-aware kinase descriptors, TopoFold Calpha curvature/torsion, direct Calpha distances (window-matched and proxies of the established distances), or local Calpha RMSD?

1OPJ.construct_differences_vs_UniProt_P00519: N-terminal tag residues; Ser at 1a position 336

1OPK.construct_differences_vs_UniProt_P00519: SH3-SH2-kinase construct; Ser at 336; D363N (HRD Asp)

numbering: c-Abl isoform 1a (UniProt P00519 canonical). Offsets were derived before this freeze by exact sequence matching of every chain to P00519 (1OPJ A 281/287 and B 283/288, 1OPK 446/449, 2F4J 285/287 identities; mismatches listed above). Landmarks checked in P00519: K271, E286, E290 (alphaC Glu+4), HRD 361-363, DFG 381-383, APE 407-409.

labels.source: Ayaz et al., Nat Commun 14:1885 (2023), Results/Methods text (not TopoFold output, not figures)
labels.note: The paper describes 1OPK as 'apo Abl kinase'; the PDB entry contains HET P16. Recorded as a discrepancy, not resolved here. Labels are applied to every chain of an entry.

alphaC_contrast: No independent alphaC label is stated for these entries. The established Modi & Dunbrack (2019) criterion (Cbeta(E286)-Cbeta(K271) <= 10 A: alphaC-in) is computed and reported; an alphaC contrast is evaluated only if both classes occur among the four chains, with the criterion itself as the reference.
residue_range: c-Abl 1a residues 240-500, Calpha present in all four chains (checked before the freeze; no gaps, no alternate locations in 260-410)

established.D1: dist(Calpha E290, Czeta F382) [Modi & Dunbrack 2019: alphaC-Glu(+4)-Calpha to DFG-Phe-Czeta] (A)
established.D2: dist(Calpha K271, Czeta F382) [beta3-Lys-Calpha to DFG-Phe-Czeta] (A)
established.alphaC_CbCb: dist(Cbeta E286, Cbeta K271) (A); <= 10 A defines alphaC-in in Modi & Dunbrack 2019
established.Aloop_Hbond_NO: dist(N of residue 386 (DFGxxX), O of residue 360 (X-HRD)) (A); the extended-A-loop backbone H-bond of Modi & Dunbrack 2019; reported as a distance, 3.5 A donor-acceptor cut stated for reference only
established.phi_psi: phi and psi of residues 380 (X-DFG), 381 (Asp), 382 (Phe) (rad, circular)

calpha_only.kappa: TopoFold core curvature, three-residue windows (i-1, i, i+1), via topofold_inputs.features
calpha_only.tau: TopoFold core torsion, four-residue windows (i-1 .. i+2), circular
calpha_only.d_i_i2: Calpha(i-1)-Calpha(i+1) distance, same windows as kappa
calpha_only.d_i_i3: Calpha(i-1)-Calpha(i+2) distance, same windows as tau
calpha_only.rmsd3: pairwise proper-rotation local Calpha RMSD of the three-residue window between chains (numpy SVD/Kabsch)

physics.DFG_flip: A DFG in/out change moves the Phe side chain by several A and changes backbone phi/psi of X-D-F. Calpha-only descriptors can only detect it through the accompanying backbone (Calpha trace) change; a pure chi1 rotation of Phe is invisible to Calpha.
physics.A_loop: Open/closed A-loop states are backbone rearrangements of a ~29-residue segment: visible to Calpha geometry in principle; kappa/tau are local and SE(3)-invariant, so a rigid displacement of an unchanged loop segment is invisible to them but visible to inter-residue distances and to superposition-based RMSD of larger regions.
physics.alphaC: alphaC in/out is largely a rigid-body helix displacement: kappa/tau inside an intact helix cannot see it; inter-element Calpha distances (proxy_alphaC) can. Side-chain salt-bridge geometry is not represented by Calpha.
physics.limits: Calpha-only representations do not encode side-chain rotamers, ring positions or hydrogen bonds directly.

regions.DFG: windows whose residues all lie in 378-386
regions.A_loop: windows whose residues all lie in 381-409
regions.alphaC: windows whose residues all lie in 279-293

decision_rule.scalar_descriptors: For a contrast with groups G1, G2 and per-chain scalar x (circular differences wrapped to [0, pi] for angles): between = min |x_i - x_j| over i in G1, j in G2; within = max |x_i - x_k| over pairs inside the same group (0 if no pair). A descriptor SEPARATES the contrast if between > within and between >= floor.
decision_rule.pairwise_rmsd: For local RMSD: between = min RMSD over cross-group chain pairs; within = max RMSD over same-group pairs (0 if none). SEPARATES if between > within and between >= floor.
decision_rule.floor_rationale: fixed before any calculation as an allowance for coordinate error at 1.75-1.91 A resolution; not tuned
decision_rule.window_metrics: For window-based representations the count of separating windows in the contrast's region and the number of windows tested are reported; equal information: every Calpha representation uses the same chains, residues and windows
outcome_per_contrast_and_representation: not assessable (contrast has a single class or missing atoms)

permitted_interpretation: Whether each representation distinguishes the stated states on these four chains only. Confounded by different ligands (imatinib, P16, VX-680), mutations (D363N in 1OPK, H396P in 2F4J), constructs (SH3-SH2-kinase vs kinase domain) and crystal forms; groups of 1-3 chains; complete separation on so few chains is not a classification accuracy and does not generalize. No biological, clinical or novelty claim.
